sources.snippet: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B Uncensored is a Mixture-of-Experts model with 35.5B total parameters and 3B activated, extended to 1M-token context with the official MTP speculative-decoding layer, delivering 1.5x decode speedup on Ollama, with native thinking and tools.
